youtube.title: In This City, Your Last Search Is Read at Your Funeral
youtube.description: An original animated dark comedy: in this city, when you die, your last search gets read out loud at your funeral. Kevin has searched nothing but hymns and broccoli for ten years. Tonight he finally types the one question he's been holding in. Pure fiction – the city, the rule and all characters are invented.

tiktok.caption: In this city, your last search gets read at your funeral. Kevin was careful. For ten years. 💀 What's YOUR last search? (Don't answer.) (fiction)
